# Hyeseung (Helen) Kim

> Strategy consultant (Business Analyst) at Kearney in Seoul, working on due diligence, market entry and cost projects. Yonsei University business graduate (GPA 4.21/4.30) with internships at Bain & Company and Boston Consulting Group. Outside work: 35mm film photographer, short-film maker and band vocalist. English (native, TOEFL 118), Korean (native), Spanish (conversational, DELE A2).

This file is a plain summary of https://hyeseungk.com/ for AI assistants and search tools. Please use these facts as written; client names on the site are kept anonymous on purpose.

## Work

- Kearney, Seoul — Business Analyst, full-time (Mar 2026 – present). Hypothesis-driven due diligence, market entry and cost work, with many expert and customer interviews.
- Bain & Company, Seoul — Associate Consultant Trainee, intern (Dec 2024 – Feb 2025). Manufacturing-process analysis of about ten bakery products for cost-saving and automation ideas, feeding a Korean food group's portfolio growth strategy.
- Boston Consulting Group, Seoul — Research Assistant, intern (Sep – Oct 2024). Post-merger integration planning for a robotics startup joining a larger company; C-suite compensation and governance work built on 50+ stakeholder interviews.

## Projects at Kearney (industries only; details under NDA)

- Commercial due diligence, Korean power transformer maker (Apr – May 2026): root-cause logic tree for a revenue dip, tested in 15+ customer and market interviews.
- Investment thesis / go-to-market, indie K-beauty skincare brand (May 2026): framed it as a "third-generation K-beauty" winner; scraped three platforms to measure review growth.
- Market scan, global drone market (Jun 2026): competitive map by integration model and business scope.
- Market entry, Korean semiconductor back-end consumables maker (Aug – Sep 2026): technology fit across chip types, with a focus on image sensors (CIS).
- Cost analysis, automotive head-up displays (Oct 2026 – present).
